releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with PowerShell 5.1 Start Menu usability improvements and long-run scan/export status feedback from #372 and #373. The release-root Start-ShareSurfer.ps1 launcher, Start-ShareSurfer menu, and startup wizard now support -ConsoleMode Auto|Enhanced|Plain so arrow-key prompts are preferred in real ConsoleHost sessions while older or redirected consoles can use plain numbered prompts. Menu-launched scan setup now preserves ObsAttribute, AdLookupMode, ManagerIdentityFormat, and console mode into command previews, Start-ShareSurferStartup, saved JSON, and generated rerun scripts. Startup ownership inputs now use a discovery screen to use found files and skip missing ones, build ownership enrichment, or enter advanced custom paths, followed by a final review/edit/cancel screen before writing files. Long identity enrichment and export classification phases now print clearer timestamped progress for root identities, group expansion, directory lookup/cache counters, potential service-account counts, conflicts, findings, permissioned groups, owner pivots, migration discovery, owner review packets, evidence confidence, and CSV writing while keeping high-frequency progress out of scan_events.csv. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
